name: @pipeworx/mcp-cnb-cz

tools.name: cnb_exchange_rates
tools.description: ČNB official daily exchange rates against the Czech koruna (CZK) for a given day. Returns one entry per listed currency (~30 currencies, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY) with country, currency, currencyCode, amount and rate. The rate is CZK per `amount` units of that currency. Omit `date` for the latest published rates. Verified live.

date.description: Day in YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-05-27". Omit for the latest published rates. Weekends/holidays return the last valid working-day rates.

tools.name: cnb_exchange_rates_currency_month
tools.description: Daily ČNB exchange rates for ONE currency across a whole month — a per-currency time series against CZK. Returns currencyCode, amount, validFor (YYYY-MM-DD) and rate for each working day in the month. Use this to chart or compare a single currency over time. Verified live.

yearMonth.description: Month in YYYY-MM, e.g. "2026-05". Omit for the current month.

tools.name: cnb_monthly_averages
tools.description: Monthly average exchange rates for ONE currency against CZK, across all available years. Returns month (e.g. "JAN"), year, currencyCode, amount and average. Useful for historical trend/year-over-year comparisons of a currency vs CZK. Verified live.

tools.name: cnb_pribor
tools.description: PRIBOR — the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (CZK money-market reference rates) for a given day. Returns one entry per tenor (period: ONE_DAY, ONE_WEEK, ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTH, SIX_MONTH, ONE_YEAR, etc.) with the pribor rate in percent. Omit `date` for the latest. Verified live.

date.description: Day in YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-05-27". Omit for the latest. Weekends/holidays return the last valid working-day fixing.

tools.name: cnb_czeonia
tools.description: CZEONIA — the Czech Overnight Index Average (the reference rate for actual overnight CZK interbank deposits) for a given day. Returns validFor, the overnight rate (percent) and traded volume in CZK millions. Omit `date` for the latest. Verified live.

date.description: Day in YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-05-27". Omit for the latest. Weekends/holidays return the last valid working-day value.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cnb-cz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cnb-cz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
